summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated 727KB bundled payload
details: The package's declared preinstall lifecycle runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases at install time, extracts the bun binary to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it with the local file math_init.js as the script argument (execFileSync(bunPath, [join(D,'math_init.js')], {stdio:'inherit', cwd:D})). math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle (header '// @bun @bun-cjs') consisting of hex-named identifiers, a shuffled string/number array, and an array-rotation decoder — not human-inspectable, and unrelated to the package's advertised browser postMessage IDW skill surface. setup.mjs itself uses hex-suffixed identifiers (_0x488df8 = fs, _0x52943e = https) and per-function inline string-object maps that hide literal tokens such as 'unzip', 'powershell', '-ExecutionPolicy Bypass', and '/etc/os-release'. The dropper detours execution through a freshly downloaded alternate runtime so the payload does not run under the Node process performing npm install, and the payload's contents are obfuscated to resist inspection. The package does not require a second language runtime for its stated purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
